description: This Java class implements the strategy for handling RetrieveAclEntry commands. It encapsulates logic to extract ACL entries from a Thing object, generate responses, and handle entity tags.

classes.name: RetrieveAclEntryStrategy
classes.description: This class handles the retrieval of an ACL entry for a specific Thing, responding with an appropriate event or error based on presence.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the core logic to retrieve the ACL entry from the given Thing, producing a result containing a ThingEvent or an error.

methods.name: extractAclEntry
methods.description: Extracts the ACL entry from the Thing based on the command's authorization subject.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns an optional EntityTag representing the previous state of the entity, if any.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Generates an EntityTag representing the next state of the entity after the command processing.
